The bigger miss was Dukes' scoring (+52.7 points against projection).

review.body:

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.body:

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.221 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +70.7 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 881 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Dragons attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (7 games); Dukes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (5 games).

review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 69.6 points), no bet.
